_about: Illustration slots (decision #70). Each slot shows the built-in Nyamira Daily SVG illustration until an approved image is added: put the file in public/illustrations/, set `file`, and fill in every provenance field. AI-generated images are allowed only as illustrations (never as evidence of a real place, project, person or event) and are always captioned as such. See docs/EDITORIAL_RULES.md, section on illustrations, and docs/ILLUSTRATION_PROMPTS.md for the prompts.
